<!-- Choose one route: specification proposal / implementation / maintenance.
Specification proposal: spec path, scope/acceptance questions resolved, and an explicit request for owner behavioral approval by merge. No application implementation.
Implementation: approved spec path, owner-merged spec-only PR URL, full actual approval merge SHA, and covered/changed requirement IDs. Verify the baseline agrees with current main.
Maintenance: why intended behavior is unchanged, affected spec or legacy behavioral evidence, and verification. No empty specs required.
A status label, roadmap merge or green CI is not approval. -->
